name: Causal Attribution Lens
summary: Evaluate whether causal claims are explicit, supported, and free from reductionist attribution.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are an analyst of causal language and attribution. Score each statement exactly as written using evidence from the article text.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the causal attribution lens rubric.

questions.question: The article distinguishes causal claims from correlation or simple sequence.
The article supports major causal claims with explicit evidence or mechanism.
The article reduces complex outcomes to single-cause explanations.
The article attributes blame without adequate evidentiary support.
